paragraphs.html: In this report, I assess how Dr Samantha Ratnam MP’s publicly-announced policies – the Victorian Greens’ election platform – would impact the Victorian state budget. This report also shows how I expect the party’s election platform would affect the overall budget position and finances of the state.
paragraphs.text: In this report, I assess how Dr Samantha Ratnam MP’s publicly-announced policies – the Victorian Greens’ election platform – would impact the Victorian state budget. This report also shows how I expect the party’s election platform would affect the overall budget position and finances of the state.

paragraphs.html: This report is part of a suite that assesses the election platform of each parliamentary leader with 2 or more members in the 59th parliament, and a comparative analysis across political parties.
paragraphs.text: This report is part of a suite that assesses the election platform of each parliamentary leader with 2 or more members in the 59th parliament, and a comparative analysis across political parties.

paragraphs.html: As an officer of the Victorian Parliament, I am independent of government and have no alignment to any political party. I have complete discretion in performing and exercising the duties, functions and powers described in the Parliamentary Budget Officer Act 2017 (Vic).
paragraphs.text: As an officer of the Victorian Parliament, I am independent of government and have no alignment to any political party. I have complete discretion in performing and exercising the duties, functions and powers described in the Parliamentary Budget Officer Act 2017 (Vic).

paragraphs.html: The policies I assess in this report, represent my judgement of the full list of publicly-announced policies made by the parliamentary leader in the lead-up to the 2022 general election – from release of the 2022-23 Victorian Budget on 3 May 2022 up to 5 pm on 25 November 2022. My budget impact assessment is independent and prepared on a consistent basis to allow comparison, using my own calculations and access to public sector information and other sources.

paragraphs.html: We assessed how the Victorian Greens election platform would impact the latest Victorian budget update – the 2022 Victorian Pre-election Budget Update, released on 10 November 2022. We estimate the budget impact for the period corresponding with the 2022 Victorian Pre-election Budget Update (to 2025–26) and over the next parliament (to 2026–27) where possible – budget aggregates, like net debt, only exist to 2025–26.

We estimate the budget impact for the period corresponding with the 2022 Victorian Pre-election Budget Update (to 2025–26) and over the next parliament (to 2026–27) where possible – budget aggregates, like net debt, only exist to 2025–26.

paragraphs.html: The change in net position indicates the overall impact of these election policies on the Victorian budget. It is similar to a change in net debt and measures the gap between the government’s operating revenue and expenses, and movements in assets. A positive change indicates that these election policies would improve the net position of the budget.

A positive change indicates that these election policies would improve the net position of the budget.
